title: Touhou Kinjoukyou ~ Fossilized Wonders - Beloved Dwelling of Dust
description:
The quaint stage 1 theme from the 20th Touhou game, Fossilized Wonders.

It has a generally calm feeling and feels like it's holding back, but it does go all-out nearing the end. I wonder if you could take a nap on those pulsating yellow hexagons.
